title: Fifteen Lessons from the Surah of the Cave (Surah Al-Kahf)

meta.name: v5_k18_16_outro
meta.title: Fifteen Lessons from the Surah of the Cave (Surah Al-Kahf)

lines.text: That was the Sūrah of the Cave.
So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone.

quran.ar: فَمَن كَانَ یَرۡجُوا۟ لِقَاۤءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡیَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلࣰا صَـٰلِحࣰا وَلَا یُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦۤ أَحَدَۢا
